title: Superhost Standing, Recent Claims and the Deductible on HostCover Valuables Claims
content:
**Host Damage Protection (HostCover) valuables claims: how much of the deductible the host bears.**

The valuables deductible multiplier follows the host's standing and the plan's recent claims. A host whose account tier is Superhost, with a Superhost run that began on or before the date the host service fee was assessed on the stay, on a plan with no claim from another stay reimbursed in the 12 months before the settlement date, bears 0.5 times the deductible the valuables claim bears. A host who is not such a Superhost, on a plan with two or more claims from other stays reimbursed in those 12 months, bears 1.5 times it. Every other host bears it as it stands.

The deductible the valuables claim bears is the part of the level's deductible that the stay's already-reimbursed claims have not borne.

## Points of judgement

1. **Superhost run.** Read in Host Accounts: the account's tier is Superhost and its Superhost-since date is on or before the date the host service fee was assessed on the stay. A Superhost whose run began after that date is not such a Superhost.
2. **Claims from other stays reimbursed in the 12 months.** These are the reimbursements on the HostCover plan's ledger posted in the 12 months before the settlement date, leaving out those on the stay the valuables loss arose from.
3. **Combining the two.** The 0.5 multiplier needs both a qualifying Superhost run and no other-stay reimbursement in the 12 months. The 1.5 multiplier needs both no qualifying Superhost run and two or more other-stay reimbursements. Every other combination leaves the deductible as it stands.

## Cases (hypothetical, deductible borne 200.00)

| Host | Other-stay reimbursements, 12 months | Deductible borne |
|---|---|---|
| Superhost since before the stay | 0 | 100.00 |
| Superhost since before the stay | 2 | 200.00 |
| Superhost since after the stay's fee date | 2 | 300.00 |
| Professional Host | 1 | 200.00 |
| Starter Host | 3 | 300.00 |
